summary_en: This study tests the da Vinci SP single-port robotic surgical system in operations on the gallbladder, stomach, esophagus, pancreas and liver, for benign and malignant disease. Each participant has one operation with the system, and the number of operations per stage is stated, but how long or how often is not stated. The study measures the safety and performance of the system and its instruments and accessories.
summary_es: Este estudio evalúa el sistema quirúrgico robótico de puerto único da Vinci SP en operaciones del hígado, la vesícula biliar, el estómago, el esófago y el páncreas, para enfermedades benignas y malignas. Cada participante tiene una operación con el sistema; la duración o la frecuencia no se indican. El estudio mide la seguridad y el desempeño del sistema, sus instrumentos y sus accesorios.
who_for: Diagnosed with a benign or malignant condition in one of the listed operation groups
Free of metastatic disease (stage-specific criteria apply)
not_for: Unable to give informed consent or contraindicated for general anesthesia or minimally invasive surgery
